summary.text: Shawn Mickelonis is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent David Watters.
A business owner, he lost to Watters in the 2024 general election for the same seat.

paragraphs.text: Shawn Mickelonis earned a high school diploma from Somersworth High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts, Lowell, in 2004, and his listed career experience is as a business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong New Hampshire resident, small business owner, former state representative, New Hampshire Department of Transportation project commissioner and chairman of the Greater Dover Republican Committee.
He said his priorities are controlling government spending, opposing broad-based taxes, lowering energy costs, and strengthening public safety.
